Impact of behavioral economics to improve antihypertensive therapy adherence, a pilot randomized controlled trial in Los Angeles. Routinized pill-taking can enhance medication adherence but is difficult to achieve. In this pilot randomized controlled trial we assess the feasibility, acceptability, and preliminary efficacy of a novel behavioral economics-based approach to medication-adherence.
